## {{< iconify octicon:comment-discussion-24 aria-hidden="true" >}} Work with Me {#work-with-me}

::: {.faq}

<details>
<summary>What do you take on as a freelance?</summary>

Tooling and publishing work only: Quarto extensions and multi-format pipelines (HTML, Typst/PDF, Reveal.js), R package development, `shiny` applications, reproducible workflows with Dev Containers and continuous integration, and training.
In practice that ranges from a single Lua filter to a full reporting pipeline with brand theming.
Biostatistics, clinical, and data-analysis work is not part of my freelance offer.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Why the distinction between freelance and employed work?</summary>

I wear two hats.
As a freelance I take on Quarto, Typst, and R engineering work in my own name.
Biostatistics goes through my employer, [Alsinova](https://www.alsinova.com/), where I am a senior biostatistician: genome-wide and epigenome-wide association studies, longitudinal and mixed models, joint longitudinal-survival modelling, and meta-analysis, with the reporting that goes with them.
If that is what you need, write to me anyway and I will point you to the right contact there.

</details>

<details>
<summary>How does a freelance engagement usually start?</summary>

With an email describing what you are trying to publish or automate, and what currently gets in the way.
I answer with a scope, a rough estimate, and the questions I need answered before quoting properly.
Short engagements of a few days work as well as multi-month ones.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Do you work remotely?</summary>

Yes, exclusively, and I have done so since 2022.
I am based in Lille, France, and used to working asynchronously with teams across time zones, on GitHub or GitLab.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Do you provide training?</summary>

Yes, on Quarto, Typst, R, and reproducible workflows with Dev Containers.
Existing material includes a two-day [Mastering Quarto CLI](https://github.com/mcanouil/mastering-quarto-cli) workshop, alongside R and Shiny courses, all adaptable to your team's level.

</details>

:::
